results.title: Declared skills answer
results.finding: Although all five named skill probes show JSON-RPC results without errors, only check and is-verified return content aligned with their declared A2A status-reading behavior; verify does not recompute a verdict hash, conditions does not provide the stated conditions, and lookup does not provide the declared record details (verdict, state, record SHA-256, and recompute URL).

results.title: Auth behaves as declared
results.finding: The embedded card declares an empty security requirement for skills and says /a2a is public while operator routes require the x-sweep-token header; every skill probe records credential_sent false with HTTP 200, and the tokenless POST /sweep probe received HTTP 403.

results.title: Disclosure present
results.finding: The embedded card bytes contain a provider object identifying The HORI… Co., Ltd. and a compensation disclosure with paid_by set to buyer.
